verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only human-operated e-filing routes: DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro client software used with a signature card, ePCT, and paper or fax filing. It shows no system-to-system channel such as system accounts, an API, or a transmitter/batch-provider program, and no published enrollment path for one. DPMAdirektPro is filing software for individual applicants, not a documented machine channel, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
